lines.say: It passed every test on your laptop. Perfectly green.
lines.show: It passed every test on your laptop. *Perfectly* green.

lines.say: Friday, five PM, you push it to the server. A minute later, it crashed.
lines.show: Friday, 5 PM, you push it to the server. A minute later, it [crashed.]

lines.say: Same exact code. Nobody had touched a thing.
lines.show: Same exact code. Nobody had touched *a thing.*

lines.say: But the server ran an older Python, and it was missing a library your code depends on.
lines.show: But the server ran an *older Python,* and it was [missing a library] your code depends on.

lines.say: That's the problem Docker solves. Don't ship your code alone. Ship it plus everything it needs, sealed in one box.
lines.show: That's the problem *Docker* solves. Don't ship your code alone. Ship it plus [everything it needs,] sealed in one box.

lines.say: It's a shipping container for software. Truck, ship or train, what's inside arrives exactly as packed.
lines.show: It's a *shipping container* for software. Truck, ship or train, what's inside arrives [exactly as packed.]

lines.say: You list everything that goes in, in a file called a Dockerfile.
lines.show: You list everything that goes in, in a file called a [Dockerfile.]

lines.say: Docker builds that into an image: your code, Python, every library, frozen together.
lines.show: Docker builds that into an *image:* your code, Python, every library, [frozen together.]

lines.say: Run the image, and you get a container: your app, running in its own box.
lines.show: Run the image, and you get a [container:] your app, running in its own box.

lines.say: Laptop, server, or cloud, the inside is identical.
lines.show: Laptop, server, or cloud, the inside is *identical.*

lines.say: If you ship code with AI, follow for the system design it quietly skips.
lines.show: If you ship code with AI, follow for the system design it quietly [skips.]
